violations.text: Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information. The last date of sale were lacking. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Various raw animal foods were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods throughout the refrigeration units in the establishment. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 25 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to use dishwasher to WASH ONLY. All equipment and utensils to be sanitized in the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Various food items were observed held at 43-55 degrees Fahrenheit in various refrigeration units/prep areas. Foods were observed stored above the fill line in the prep units, in an ice bath with inadequate ice, and/or stored in an overfilled sliding door refrigeration unit at the cookline. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All foods were moved from refrigeration to the prep areas 2 hours prior to inspection. All foods moved to walk-in refrigerator or blast chiller to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked (caesar dressing). The item must have an asterisk to inform the consumer of the raw/undercooked ingredients. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Rollatini was prepped and placed in the refrigerator in containers and covered. Cooling methods reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Tiramisu made in the establishment was observed thawing on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The door to the outside, located downstairs near the mopsink, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026
The condensate from the espresso machine is draining into a hand sink. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026
The prep sink in the pastry area was observed with a hand towel dispenser. Hand washing aids must only be at a handwashing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

The door to the outside, located downstairs to the dumpster area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

The cutting boards of the prep units upstairs are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the beverage tubing near the ice well in the upstairs bar was observed with tape. All non-food contact surfaces must be easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2025

The faucet at the upstairs bar was observed to be in poor repair (faucet not connected). A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025
The condensate from the espresso machine is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025

1) The floor tiles in the top kitchen area is in poor repair (missing grout). 2) The ceiling tile in the downstairs dry storage area is in poor repair (water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/17/2025
